criteria.source_text: lift must carry the weight at the launch speed the animal can actually reach
a realistic glide: at least 10 m from a 1 m launch

rows.why: the real adult flying fish glides; if this fails the check is broken, not the animal

standing.limiting_factor: the engine has no geometry for it: STATE carries areas and a span but no longitudinal positions, and the mesh manifests carry only a per-object centre, which is neither a planform AREA CENTROID nor a CENTRE OF MASS. Estimating the margin from that object centre gives about -43 % MAC for the adult flying fish against the -7.7 % MEASURED by anatomy-model/print/balance_1to1.py on a real 1:1 flying-fish mesh, a factor of five on the one instance available, so no number is reported here.
